MONTHS = {

    "feb": "February",
    "mar": "March",

    "may": "May",
    "jun": "June",
    "jul": "July",

}

DATE_PATTERNS = [
    r"\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}",
    r"\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}-\d{2,4}",
    r"\d{1,2}\s*(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\s*\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?",
    r"\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s*(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\s*\d{2,4}",
    r"\d{2}:\d{2}?(?::\d{2}?)?",
]


def number_to_words(num_str, class_type):
    """Convert numeric string to words based on class type"""
    try:
        num = int(num_str)
        if num < 0 or num > 999999:
            return num_str
        if num == 0:
            return "zero"
        parts = []
        if num >= 100000:
            parts.append(str(num // 100000) + " hundred thousand")
            num %= 100000
        if num >= 10000:
            parts.append(str(num // 10000) + " thousand")
            num %= 10000
        if num >= 1000:
            parts.append(str(num // 1000) + " thousand")
            num %= 1000
        if num >= 100:
            parts.append(ONE_TO_NINETY_NINETY.get(num // 100, "") + " hundred")
            num %= 100
        if num >= 20:
            tens = num // 10
            ones = num % 10
            if tens > 1:
                parts.append(
                    ONE_TO_NINETY_NINETY[tens * 10] + ("-" if ones > 0 else "")
                )
                if ones > 0:
                    parts[-1] = parts[-1].rstrip("-") + ONE_TO_NINETY_NINETY[ones]
            else:
                parts.append(ONE_TO_NINETY_NINETY[num])
        elif num > 0:
            parts.append(ONE_TO_NINETY_NINETY[num])
    except:
        return num_str
    return " ".join(parts)


def extract_year(text):
    """Extract and convert year-like patterns"""
    patterns = [
        (r"(\d{4})", r"\g<1>"),
        (r"(\d{2})(?:\s*st|nd|rd|th)?", r"\g<1>"),
    ]
    for pattern, replacement in patterns:
        text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return text


def classify_token(text, fallback_rules):
    """Infer class type from text content with improved patterns"""
    text_lower = text.lower().strip()
    text_clean = re.sub(r"[$£€]", "", text)

    # Currency patterns
    if any(
        c in text
        for c in [
            "$",
            "£",
            "€",
            "dollar",
            "dollars",
            "cent",
            "cents",
            "pound",
            "pounds",
        ]
    ):
        return "CURRENCY"

    # Time patterns (more comprehensive)
    if ":" in text or re.search(r"\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?(?::\d{2}?)?", text):
        return "DATE"

    # Date patterns (month names)
    for month in MONTHS.keys():
        if month in text_lower:
            return "DATE"

    # Numeric patterns
    if re.search(r"\d+\.?\d*", text):
        return "DATE"

    # Punctuation patterns
    if re.match(r"^[^\w\s]*$", text) or text in [
        ".",
        ",",
        "!",
        "?",
        '"',
        "'",
        "-",
        "/",
    ]:
        return "PUNCT"

    # Letter patterns
    if re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+$", text):
        return "LETTERS"

    return "PLAIN"


def compute_accuracy(predictions, actuals):
    """Compute token-level sequence accuracy"""
    if len(predictions) != len(actuals):
        return 0.0
    correct = sum(1 for p, a in zip(predictions, actuals) if str(p) == str(a))
    return correct / len(predictions)


def create_class_mappings(df, use_full=False):
    """Create (before, class) -> after mappings"""
    mappings = {}
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        before = str(row["before"]).strip()
        if before:
            if before not in mappings:
                mappings[before] = {}
            if row["class"] not in mappings[before]:
                mappings[before][row["class"]] = str(row["after"]).strip()
    return mappings

    text_lower = text.lower().strip()

def predict_after(text, class_type, all_mappings):
    """Predict normalized text with class-aware mapping"""
    text = str(text).strip()
    if not text:
        return text

    try:
        # Try exact (text, class) match first
        if text in all_mappings:
            class_specific = all_mappings[text]
            if isinstance(class_specific, dict):
                result = class_specific.get(class_type, "")
                if result:
                    return result
            elif isinstance(class_specific, str):
                return class_specific

        # Try punctuation normalization
        result = normalize_punctuation(text)
        if result in all_mappings:
            class_specific = all_mappings[result]
            if isinstance(class_specific, dict):
                result = class_specific.get(class_type, "")
                if result:
                    return result
            elif isinstance(class_specific, str):
                return class_specific

        # Try class-aware numeric fallback
        if text.isdigit():
            return number_to_words(text, class_type)

        # For letters, try to match with PLAIN class
        if class_type == "LETTERS" and text in all_mappings:
            class_specific = all_mappings[text]
            if isinstance(class_specific, str):
                return class_specific

        return text
    except Exception:
        return text


def normalize_punctuation(text):
    """Handle some punctuation normalization"""
    text = str(text).strip()
    if text == "":
        return text
    return text


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")
    print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
    print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

    # Create train/val split (this split is used for validation but we don't refit)
    print("Creating train/val split...")
    train_subset, val_subset = train_test_split(
        train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["class"]
    )
    print(f"Train subset size: {len(train_subset)}")
    print(f"Validation subset size: {len(val_subset)}")

    # Build class-aware mappings from TRAIN ONLY (train_subset)
    print("Building class-aware mappings from training subset...")
    train_mappings = create_class_mappings(train_subset)

    # Get fallback rules
    fallback_rules = create_fallback_class_rules()

    # Evaluate on validation set (clean hold-out, never used for mapping creation)
    print("Evaluating on validation set (clean hold-out)...")
    val_ids = []
    val_preds = []
    val_actuals = []

    for _, row in val_subset.iterrows():
        before = str(row["before"]).strip()
        class_type = row["class"]
        pred = predict_after(before, class_type, train_mappings)
        actual = str(row["after"]).strip()
        val_ids.append(f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}")
        val_preds.append(pred)
        val_actuals.append(actual)

    # Compute accuracy
    val_accuracy = compute_accuracy(val_preds, val_actuals)
    print(f"Validation accuracy (clean hold-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

    # Save validation check
    val_submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": val_ids, "after": val_preds})
    val_submission.to_csv("./submission/val_check.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved validation check: {len(val_submission)} rows")

    # Use FULL training data for submission (but validation was on train_subset only)
    print("Using full training data for submission...")
    full_mappings = create_class_mappings(train_df)

    # Generate test predictions
    print("Generating test predictions...")
    test_df = test_df.sort_values(["sentence_id", "token_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    test_ids = []
    test_predictions = []

    for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
        before = str(row["before"]).strip()
        # Infer class for test data (no class column)
        class_type = classify_token(before, fallback_rules)
        pred = predict_after(before, class_type, full_mappings)
        test_ids.append(f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}")
        test_predictions.append(pred)

    # Create submission file
    print("Creating submission file...")
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_predictions})

    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission: {len(submission)} rows")

    # Preview
    print("\nSubmission preview (first 10 rows):")
    print(submission.head(10).to_string())

    # Final metrics
    print(f"\n=== FINAL METRICS ===")
    print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission)}")
    print(f"Validation accuracy (clean hold-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")
    print(f"Model: Fixed class-aware mappings + improved class inference")


def create_fallback_class_rules():
    """Create class-specific fallback rules"""
    fallback = {
        "DATE": {
            "numeric_prefix": True,
            "abbreviations": MONTHS.copy(),
        },
        "PLAIN": {"numeric_prefix": False},
        "PUNCT": {"numeric_prefix": False},
        "LETTERS": {"numeric_prefix": False},
        "CURRENCY": {"numeric_prefix": True},
    }
    return fallback


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
